text: 浮云游子意，落日故人情
pinyin: fú yún yóu zǐ yì, luò rì gù rén qíng
literal: floating · clouds · wanderer · 's · mind, setting · sun · old · friend · 's · feeling
natural: a wanderer's mind is a drifting cloud; a friend's feeling, the setting sun

meaning.en: At a parting, the traveller's restless heart is like a drifting cloud, and the old friend's reluctance is like the sun lingering as it sets.
meaning.zh: 送别时，游子的心像飘浮的云般漂泊不定，故人的依依不舍如同徘徊不落的夕阳。

equivalents: a heart adrift like a cloud, a friend's regret like the setting sun

examples.zh: 临别时，他在贺卡上写下“浮云游子意，落日故人情”。
examples.en: At the parting he wrote on the card, 'A wanderer's mind is a drifting cloud; a friend's feeling, the setting sun.'

examples.zh: 毕业典礼上，老师用“浮云游子意，落日故人情”送别学生。
examples.en: At graduation the teacher sent the students off with 'a wanderer's mind is a drifting cloud; a friend's feeling, the setting sun'.

story.en: Li Bai's farewell poem to a friend, which opens '青山横北郭，白水绕东城' and closes with the parting horse's neigh. This is its third couplet.
story.zh: 李白送别友人之作，开头是“青山横北郭，白水绕东城”，此为第三联。

usage.en: Quoted at farewells between friends. Literary register.
usage.zh: 多用于朋友送别，书面语。

text: 请君试问东流水，别意与之谁短长
pinyin: qǐng jūn shì wèn dōng liú shuǐ, bié yì yǔ zhī shéi duǎn cháng
literal: please · you · try · ask · east-flowing · water, parting · feeling · and · it · which · short · long
natural: ask the river that flows east: which is longer, its course or our parting sorrow?

meaning.en: Ask the eastward-flowing river whether its length or the sorrow of parting is greater; the feeling of parting is as endless as the water.
meaning.zh: 请你问问向东流去的江水，它和离别的情意相比，哪个更长？意思是离愁像江水一样绵长。

equivalents: our parting sorrow runs as deep as the river

examples.zh: 站台上，她轻声念起“请君试问东流水，别意与之谁短长”。
examples.en: On the platform she softly recited, 'Ask the river that flows east, which is longer, its course or our parting sorrow?'

examples.zh: 朋友远行前夜，我们读着“请君试问东流水，别意与之谁短长”，一夜无眠。
examples.en: The night before my friend left we read 'ask the river that flows east…' and neither of us slept.

story.en: Li Bai wrote this when leaving Jinling (Nanjing), where friends saw him off at a tavern; the couplet ends the poem.
story.zh: 李白离开金陵时，友人在酒肆为他送行，作此诗留别，这两句是全诗的结尾。

usage.en: Quoted for the sorrow of parting. Literary register.
usage.zh: 用于表达离别之愁，书面语。

text: 古来圣贤皆寂寞，惟有饮者留其名
pinyin: gǔ lái shèng xián jiē jì mò, wéi yǒu yǐn zhě liú qí míng
literal: ancient · times · sages · worthies · all · lonely, only · have · drinkers · leave · their · names
natural: since ancient times sages have all been forgotten; only the drinkers leave a name

meaning.en: A bitter-humorous remark: sages and worthies of old lived unrecognised, and only the great drinkers have been remembered.
meaning.zh: 带着愤懑的自嘲：自古圣人贤士都默默无闻，只有爱喝酒的人才留下了名声。

equivalents: only the drinkers are remembered

examples.zh: 酒过三巡，他半开玩笑地念起“古来圣贤皆寂寞，惟有饮者留其名”。
examples.en: Three rounds in, he half-jokingly recited 'since ancient times sages have all been forgotten; only the drinkers leave a name'.

examples.zh: 李白那句“古来圣贤皆寂寞，惟有饮者留其名”，常被拿来给喝酒找理由。
examples.en: Li Bai's 'sages all lonely, only drinkers leave a name' is often used as an excuse for drinking.

story.en: From Li Bai's drinking song 'Bring in the Wine', in which he urges his friends to drink and voices his frustration at neglected talent.
story.zh: 出自李白的劝酒诗《将进酒》，诗人劝友人痛饮，并抒发怀才不遇的愤慨。

usage.en: Often quoted lightheartedly at drinking parties; in the poem it carries real frustration at being unappreciated. Literary register.
usage.zh: 常在酒席上半开玩笑地引用；原诗中则含有怀才不遇的愤懑。书面语。

text: 白发三千丈，缘愁似个长
pinyin: bái fà sān qiān zhàng, yuán chóu sì gè cháng
literal: white · hair · three · thousand · zhang, because · of · sorrow · as · this · long
natural: white hair three thousand zhang long, grown that long from sorrow

meaning.en: A famously exaggerated image: my white hair is three thousand zhang long, and all of it has grown from sorrow.
meaning.zh: 著名的夸张手法：白发长达三千丈，全是因为忧愁才长得这样长。

equivalents: my sorrow has turned my hair white and long

examples.zh: 语文课上，老师用“白发三千丈，缘愁似个长”讲解夸张手法。
examples.en: In Chinese class the teacher used 'white hair three thousand zhang long, grown that long from sorrow' to explain hyperbole.

examples.zh: 熬夜赶论文的那周，他苦笑着说：白发三千丈，缘愁似个长。
examples.en: During the week of all-nighters on his thesis he said with a wry smile: 'White hair three thousand zhang long, grown that long from sorrow.'

story.en: Written by Li Bai on a visit to Qiupu (in today's Anhui), in the poem's first couplet, where he looks at himself in the mirror.
story.zh: 李白游秋浦（今安徽池州）时所作，这是组诗第十五首的首联，写他对镜自照。

usage.en: The standard example of hyperbole in Chinese poetry; also quoted jokingly about worry. A zhang (丈) is about three metres in modern usage. Literary register.
usage.zh: 中国诗歌中夸张手法的经典例子，也常被半开玩笑地用来说烦恼。丈是长度单位。书面语。

text: 白头搔更短，浑欲不胜簪
pinyin: bái tóu sāo gèng duǎn, hún yù bù shèng zān
literal: white · head · scratch · more · short, nearly · about to · cannot · bear · hairpin
natural: scratching my white head, the hair grows shorter, hardly enough to hold a pin

meaning.en: My grey hair thins the more I scratch my head in worry, until it can scarcely hold a hairpin.
meaning.zh: 愁得频频搔头，白发越搔越少，几乎连发簪都插不住了。

equivalents: so worried that my hair has thinned

examples.zh: 读到“白头搔更短，浑欲不胜簪”，学生体会到了杜甫的忧国之情。
examples.en: Reading 'scratching my white head, the hair grows shorter, hardly enough to hold a pin', the students felt Du Fu's anxiety for his country.

examples.zh: 父亲头发稀疏，我常想起“白头搔更短，浑欲不胜簪”。
examples.en: My father's hair is thin, and I often think of 'scratching my white head, the hair grows shorter, hardly enough to hold a pin'.

story.en: The closing couplet of Du Fu's 'Spring View', written in Chang'an after it fell in the An Lushan rebellion (the poem opens '国破山河在').
story.zh: 《春望》的结尾两句，作于安史之乱中长安沦陷之后（全诗以“国破山河在”开头）。

usage.en: Du Fu wrote it in 757 while detained in the rebel-held capital Chang'an. Quoted for care-worn ageing. Literary register.
usage.zh: 杜甫757年困居被叛军占领的长安时所作。多用于形容忧愁致老。书面语。

text: 万里悲秋常作客，百年多病独登台
pinyin: wàn lǐ bēi qiū cháng zuò kè, bǎi nián duō bìng dú dēng tái
literal: ten thousand · li · sad · autumn · often · be · guest, hundred · years · many · illnesses · alone · climb · terrace
natural: far from home, always a guest, grieving the autumn; sick through life, I climb the height alone

meaning.en: Far from home in the sad autumn, a lifelong guest in strange places; frail and sick in old age, I climb the terrace alone.
meaning.zh: 在万里之外的他乡，常年漂泊，悲叹秋景；一生多病，如今独自登高。

equivalents: far from home, ailing and alone

examples.zh: 重阳节登高，他不由得念起“万里悲秋常作客，百年多病独登台”。
examples.en: Climbing the heights on Double Ninth, he could not help reciting 'far from home, always a guest, grieving the autumn; sick through life, I climb alone'.

examples.zh: 异乡漂泊多年的人，读到“万里悲秋常作客，百年多病独登台”常会落泪。
examples.en: Those who have drifted for years in strange lands often weep at 'far from home, always a guest…'.

story.en: Du Fu composed 'Climbing the Heights' in 767 at Kuizhou (Sichuan), in his last years and in poor health; this is its third couplet.
story.zh: 杜甫767年在夔州（今重庆奉节）晚年多病时作《登高》，这是其颔联后的颈联。

usage.en: Quoted for loneliness away from home in autumn. Often praised as one of the finest couplets in Tang poetry. Literary register.
usage.zh: 常用来写秋天漂泊异乡的孤独，被誉为唐诗名联之一。书面语。

text: 此曲只应天上有，人间能得几回闻
pinyin: cǐ qǔ zhǐ yīng tiān shàng yǒu, rén jiān néng dé jǐ huí wén
literal: this · tune · only · should · heaven · on · exist, human · world · can · get · how many · times · hear
natural: this music should belong to heaven; how often can mortals hear it?

meaning.en: Praise for superb music: such a tune ought to exist only in heaven, and ordinary people rarely get to hear it.
meaning.zh: 称赞音乐美妙绝伦：这样的曲子应该只有天上才有，人间难得听到几回。

equivalents: music from heaven
a performance to remember

examples.zh: 听完那场音乐会，我只想说：“此曲只应天上有，人间能得几回闻。”
examples.en: After the concert I could only say, 'This music should belong to heaven; how often can mortals hear it?'

examples.zh: 评论文章用“此曲只应天上有，人间能得几回闻”来称赞她的演奏。
examples.en: The review praised her playing with 'this music should belong to heaven; how often can mortals hear it?'

story.en: Du Fu wrote this quatrain in Chengdu to the general Hua Jingding (花卿), at whose banquet he heard the music.
story.zh: 杜甫在成都为将军花敬定（花卿）所作的绝句，写在宴席上听乐的感受。

usage.en: Used to praise a superb musical performance; the line is sometimes read as a veiled barb at the official 花卿, but today it is quoted as plain praise. Literary register.
usage.zh: 用来赞美绝妙的音乐演奏；旧说此诗含讽意，今天一般只作纯粹的赞美。书面语。

text: 窗含西岭千秋雪，门泊东吴万里船
pinyin: chuāng hán xī lǐng qiān qiū xuě, mén bó dōng wú wàn lǐ chuán
literal: window · holds · western · ridge · thousand · autumns · snow, door · moors · eastern · Wu · ten thousand · li · boats
natural: the window frames a thousand years of snow on the western ridge; at the door lie boats from distant Wu

meaning.en: From my window I see the snow of the Western Ridge that never melts; at my door are moored boats that have come from far-off Wu in the east.
meaning.zh: 窗中可见西岭终年不化的积雪，门前停泊着从万里之外的东吴驶来的船只。

equivalents: a window on a snowy range, a door open to distant boats

examples.zh: 民宿的门联写着“窗含西岭千秋雪，门泊东吴万里船”。
examples.en: The inn's door couplet reads 'the window frames a thousand years of snow on the western ridge; at the door lie boats from distant Wu'.

examples.zh: 站在草堂前，他想起“窗含西岭千秋雪，门泊东吴万里船”的开阔景象。
examples.en: Standing before the thatched cottage he thought of the wide view in 'the window frames a thousand years of snow on the western ridge…'.

story.en: Written by Du Fu at his thatched cottage in Chengdu in 764, after returning there; the Western Ridge is the Xiling snow mountain.
story.zh: 764年杜甫重返成都草堂后所作，西岭指岷山的西岭雪山。

usage.en: Often used for a window view, as a couplet inscription, or in calligraphy. Literary register.
usage.zh: 常用来描写窗外景色，也常作楹联、书法题材。书面语。

text: 花径不曾缘客扫，蓬门今始为君开
pinyin: huā jìng bù céng yuán kè sǎo, péng mén jīn shǐ wèi jūn kāi
literal: flower · path · never · for · guest · swept, brushwood · gate · today · first · for · you · opened
natural: the flower path was never swept for a guest; my humble gate opens today for you

meaning.en: I have never swept this flower path for a visitor, and my humble gate opens for the first time today for you.
meaning.zh: 花间小路从来没有为客人打扫过，这简陋的家门今天才第一次为您打开。

equivalents: roll out the red carpet
you honour my humble home

examples.zh: 请客时，主人笑着说：“花径不曾缘客扫，蓬门今始为君开。”
examples.en: Welcoming his guest, the host said with a smile, 'The flower path was never swept for a guest; my humble gate opens today for you.'

examples.zh: 邀请函上写着“花径不曾缘客扫，蓬门今始为君开”，十分风雅。
examples.en: The invitation read 'the flower path was never swept for a guest; my humble gate opens today for you', very elegant.

story.en: Du Fu wrote this when the local official Cui visited his Chengdu cottage in 760 (the poem's note says 喜崔明府相过).
story.zh: 杜甫于760年在成都草堂迎接来访的崔县令时所作（原注“喜崔明府相过”）。

usage.en: A humble, courteous welcome to an honoured guest, usually in writing or as a toast. Literary register.
usage.zh: 主人欢迎贵客时的谦敬之语，多见于书面或敬酒时。书面语。

text: 飘飘何所似，天地一沙鸥
pinyin: piāo piāo hé suǒ sì, tiān dì yī shā ōu
literal: drifting · drifting · what · place · resemble, heaven · earth · one · sand · gull
natural: drifting, drifting: what am I like? A lone gull between sky and earth

meaning.en: Drifting without a home, what am I like? A single sandbank gull alone between heaven and earth.
meaning.zh: 四处漂泊，我像什么呢？像天地之间一只孤独的沙鸥。

equivalents: a lone gull adrift in the world

examples.zh: 他漂泊半生，常自比“飘飘何所似，天地一沙鸥”。
examples.en: Having drifted half his life, he often compared himself to 'drifting, drifting: what am I like? A lone gull between sky and earth'.

examples.zh: 夜里读到“飘飘何所似，天地一沙鸥”，她想起了远方的家。
examples.en: Reading 'drifting, drifting: what am I like? A lone gull between sky and earth' at night, she thought of her far-off home.

story.en: Du Fu wrote it in 765 while sailing down the Yangtze with his family after leaving Chengdu; these are the last two lines.
story.zh: 765年杜甫离开成都、携家乘舟东下途中所作，这是全诗最后两句。

usage.en: Quoted for a rootless, solitary life. Literary register.
usage.zh: 用来写漂泊孤独的人生，书面语。

text: 竹喧归浣女，莲动下渔舟
pinyin: zhú xuān guī huàn nǚ, lián dòng xià yú zhōu
literal: bamboo · rustles · returning · washerwomen, lotus · stirs · descending · fishing · boat
natural: bamboo rustles as the washerwomen go home; lotus leaves stir as a fishing boat slips down

meaning.en: The bamboo grove rustles with washerwomen returning home, and the lotus leaves sway as a fishing boat glides by.
meaning.zh: 竹林喧响，原来是洗衣的姑娘们归来；莲叶摇动，原来是渔舟顺流而下。

equivalents: signs of life in a quiet evening landscape

examples.zh: 读着“竹喧归浣女，莲动下渔舟”，仿佛闻到了雨后山村的清香。
examples.en: Reading 'bamboo rustles as the washerwomen go home; lotus leaves stir as a fishing boat slips down', one seems to smell the fresh air of a hill village after rain.

examples.zh: 画家想把“竹喧归浣女，莲动下渔舟”的意境画出来。
examples.en: The painter wanted to capture the mood of 'bamboo rustles as the washerwomen go home; lotus leaves stir…'.

story.en: Wang Wei's poem of a mountain dwelling at autumn dusk after rain; this is its third couplet.
story.zh: 王维写雨后秋晚山居的名篇，这是其颈联。

usage.en: Often cited as an example of sound heard before the cause is seen. Literary register.
usage.zh: 常被举为先闻其声、后见其人的写法范例。书面语。

text: 江流天地外，山色有无中
pinyin: jiāng liú tiān dì wài, shān sè yǒu wú zhōng
literal: river · flows · heaven · earth · beyond, mountain · colour · exist · not · within
natural: the river flows beyond heaven and earth; the mountains' colour is there and not there

meaning.en: The river seems to flow out beyond the edge of the world, and the mountains lie in a haze between seen and unseen.
meaning.zh: 江水好像流到了天地之外，远山笼罩在烟雾中若隐若现。

equivalents: a landscape between seen and unseen

examples.zh: 船行江上，他说：“江流天地外，山色有无中，真是写景绝唱。”
examples.en: Sailing along the river he said, 'The river flows beyond heaven and earth; the mountains' colour is there and not there: truly a peerless landscape line.'

examples.zh: 画展上有一幅水墨，题着“江流天地外，山色有无中”。
examples.en: At the exhibition hung an ink painting inscribed 'the river flows beyond heaven and earth; the mountains' colour is there and not there'.

story.en: Wang Wei's poem on viewing the Han River (in today's Hubei); this is its second couplet.
story.zh: 王维描写远望汉江（在今湖北）景色的诗，这是其颔联。

usage.en: Used to praise misty, boundless river-and-mountain scenery; the poem is also titled 《汉江临眺》 in some editions. Literary register.
usage.zh: 用来赞美烟水苍茫的江山景色；诗题另有《汉江临眺》一说。书面语。

text: 开轩面场圃，把酒话桑麻
pinyin: kāi xuān miàn chǎng pǔ, bǎ jiǔ huà sāng má
literal: open · window · face · threshing ground · garden, hold · wine · chat · mulberry · hemp
natural: open the window to the fields; cup in hand, chat of mulberry and hemp

meaning.en: We open the window onto the yard and garden, and with wine in hand chat of crops like mulberry and hemp: simple country talk among friends.
meaning.zh: 打开窗子面对打谷场和菜园，端着酒杯闲谈农事，写出乡间朋友相聚的闲适。

equivalents: chatting over a drink about the harvest

examples.zh: 周末到乡下老友家，真是“开轩面场圃，把酒话桑麻”。
examples.en: At my old friend's place in the country at the weekend, it was truly 'open the window to the fields; cup in hand, chat of mulberry and hemp'.

examples.zh: 他退休后回到老家，过上了开轩面场圃，把酒话桑麻的日子。
examples.en: After retiring he returned home and lived the life of 'open the window to the fields; cup in hand, chat of mulberry and hemp'.

story.en: Meng Haoran visited a friend's farmhouse and wrote this poem; the couplet is the fifth and sixth lines.
story.zh: 孟浩然应邀到老友农家做客所作，这是诗的第五、六句。

usage.en: Describes relaxed rural hospitality; 话桑麻 is also used by itself for chatting about farming or everyday things. Literary register.
usage.zh: 形容悠闲的田园待客；“话桑麻”也单用，指闲谈农事或家常。书面语。

text: 春宵苦短日高起，从此君王不早朝
pinyin: chūn xiāo kǔ duǎn rì gāo qǐ, cóng cǐ jūn wáng bù zǎo cháo
literal: spring · night · bitterly · short · sun · high · rise, from · this · ruler · not · early · court
natural: spring nights are bitterly short, they rise when the sun is high; from then on the emperor held no morning court

meaning.en: The spring night is too short for the lovers, who rise late in the day; from then on the emperor no longer attended morning court.
meaning.zh: 春夜太短，天亮了还不起床；从此君王再也不早早上朝处理政事。

equivalents: to neglect duty for love

examples.zh: 新婚夫妇睡到日上三竿，朋友打趣：“春宵苦短日高起，从此君王不早朝。”
examples.en: The newlyweds slept till noon, and friends teased, 'Spring nights are bitterly short, they rise when the sun is high; from then on the emperor held no morning court.'

examples.zh: 读《长恨歌》，“春宵苦短日高起，从此君王不早朝”写出了君王的沉溺。
examples.en: In 'Song of Everlasting Sorrow', the lines 'spring nights are bitterly short…' show the emperor's infatuation.

story.en: Bai Juyi's long narrative poem on Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei, written in 806.
story.zh: 白居易806年所作的长篇叙事诗，写唐玄宗与杨贵妃的故事。

usage.en: In the poem, a mild criticism of Emperor Xuanzong's neglect of government; today often quoted jokingly about oversleeping. Literary register.
usage.zh: 在诗中含有对唐玄宗荒废朝政的委婉批评；今天常被半开玩笑地用来说睡懒觉。书面语。

text: 东船西舫悄无言，唯见江心秋月白
pinyin: dōng chuán xī fǎng qiāo wú yán, wéi jiàn jiāng xīn qiū yuè bái
literal: east · boat · west · pleasure-boat · quiet · no · words, only · see · river · heart · autumn · moon · white
natural: boats east and west fall silent; only the autumn moon, white on the river, is seen

meaning.en: The boats on every side are hushed after the song, and only the white autumn moon on the middle of the river remains.
meaning.zh: 琵琶曲终，周围的船只都静悄悄的，只见秋月清白地映在江心。

equivalents: a hush after the music ends

examples.zh: 演奏结束后全场静默，有人轻轻念道：“东船西舫悄无言，唯见江心秋月白。”
examples.en: The hall was silent after the performance, and someone murmured, 'Boats east and west fall silent; only the autumn moon, white on the river, is seen.'

examples.zh: 《琵琶行》里“东船西舫悄无言，唯见江心秋月白”一句，余韵悠长。
examples.en: In 'The Pipa Song', the line 'boats east and west fall silent…' lingers long.

story.en: In Bai Juyi's 'Song of the Pipa' (816), he hears a lute-player on a boat at Xunyang River; the line follows her performance.
story.zh: 白居易《琵琶行》（816年）写他在浔阳江头听船上女子弹琵琶，这是演奏之后的描写。

usage.en: Quoted to describe the silence that follows a moving performance. Literary register.
usage.zh: 用来形容感人的演奏结束后的寂静。书面语。

text: 晚来天欲雪，能饮一杯无
pinyin: wǎn lái tiān yù xuě, néng yǐn yī bēi wú
literal: evening · comes · sky · about to · snow, can · drink · one · cup · [question]
natural: evening comes and it looks like snow: can you drink a cup with me?

meaning.en: Dusk is falling and snow is coming; will you come for a cup of wine? A warm, casual invitation from one friend to another.
meaning.zh: 傍晚天阴，眼看要下雪了，能来喝一杯吗？是朋友之间亲切随意的邀请。

equivalents: fancy a drink on a cold evening?
come round for a warm drink

examples.zh: 下雪前一天，他给朋友发了一条短信：“晚来天欲雪，能饮一杯无？”
examples.en: The day before the snow, he texted a friend, 'Evening comes and it looks like snow: can you drink a cup with me?'

examples.zh: 冬夜围炉煮茶，大家想起了“晚来天欲雪，能饮一杯无”。
examples.en: Around the stove with tea on a winter night, everyone thought of 'evening comes and it looks like snow: can you drink a cup with me?'

story.en: A short poem by Bai Juyi inviting his friend Liu Shijiu (刘十九) to share new wine ('绿蚁新醅酒，红泥小火炉').
story.zh: 白居易邀请友人刘十九共饮的小诗，前两句是“绿蚁新醅酒，红泥小火炉”。

usage.en: Often used as a friendly invitation; 无 is a spoken question particle (= 吗). Literary but warm in tone.
usage.zh: 常用作朋友间亲切的邀请；“无”是口语疑问词，相当于“吗”。书面语，语气温暖。

text: 斯是陋室，惟吾德馨
pinyin: sī shì lòu shì, wéi wú dé xīn
literal: this · is · humble · room, only · my · virtue · fragrant
natural: this is a humble room, but my virtue makes it fragrant

meaning.en: Though my room is humble, the good character of its owner fills it with fragrance.
meaning.zh: 这虽是简陋的屋子，但主人品德高尚，屋子也就芬芳了。

equivalents: a humble home made noble by its owner
virtue makes the home

examples.zh: 新居虽小，他在门口贴上“斯是陋室，惟吾德馨”。
examples.en: His new home was small, but he pasted 'this is a humble room, but my virtue makes it fragrant' by the door.

examples.zh: 房子再破，也要有“斯是陋室，惟吾德馨”的心态。
examples.en: However shabby the house, keep the attitude of 'this is a humble room, but my virtue makes it fragrant'.

story.en: Liu Yuxi wrote this short inscription about his modest dwelling after being demoted to Hezhou; it is a standard school text.
story.zh: 刘禹锡被贬和州后，为自己简陋的居所作此铭，是中学语文必读篇目。

usage.en: Quoted to express contentment with modest surroundings; also used playfully about a small or messy home. Literary register.
usage.zh: 用来表示安于简朴的居所；也常半开玩笑地形容自己狭小凌乱的住处。书面语。

text: 谈笑有鸿儒，往来无白丁
pinyin: tán xiào yǒu hóng rú, wǎng lái wú bái dīng
literal: chat · laugh · have · great · scholars, come · go · no · commoners
natural: great scholars to chat with, no unlettered folk to visit

meaning.en: Those who talk and laugh with me are learned scholars, and no uneducated people come and go.
meaning.zh: 一起谈笑的都是博学的人，来往的没有不识字的平民。

equivalents: good company, no riffraff

examples.zh: 书房里挂着“谈笑有鸿儒，往来无白丁”，主人很有书卷气。
examples.en: In the study hung 'great scholars to chat with, no unlettered folk to visit', and its owner had a scholarly air.

examples.zh: 读书会的宗旨是“谈笑有鸿儒，往来无白丁”，却被成员们笑称太高冷。
examples.en: The reading group's motto was 'great scholars to chat with, no unlettered folk to visit', which members teased as too aloof.

story.en: From the same inscription as 斯是陋室，惟吾德馨, describing the scholarly company the author kept.
story.zh: 与“斯是陋室，惟吾德馨”出自同一篇铭文，写作者交往的多是饱学之士。

usage.en: Describes cultured company, but 白丁 (commoner) may sound snobbish, so today it is often used playfully. Literary register.
usage.zh: 形容交往的都是有学问的人；“白丁”带有轻视意味，今天常带玩笑口吻。书面语。

text: 朱雀桥边野草花，乌衣巷口夕阳斜
pinyin: zhū què qiáo biān yě cǎo huā, wū yī xiàng kǒu xī yáng xié
literal: Vermilion Bird · bridge · beside · wild · grass · flowers, Black Robe · lane · mouth · setting · sun · slants
natural: wild flowers by Zhuque Bridge; at Wuyi Lane's mouth the sun slants low

meaning.en: Wild grass and flowers grow by the Zhuque Bridge, and the setting sun slants over Wuyi Lane: a once-grand place now faded.
meaning.zh: 朱雀桥边长满野草野花，乌衣巷口夕阳西斜，昔日繁华之地如今已衰败冷落。

equivalents: a grand place now overgrown
the glory faded

examples.zh: 站在旧址前，他念起“朱雀桥边野草花，乌衣巷口夕阳斜”。
examples.en: Standing before the old site, he recited 'wild flowers by Zhuque Bridge; at Wuyi Lane's mouth the sun slants low'.

examples.zh: 导游说，“朱雀桥边野草花，乌衣巷口夕阳斜”写的就是南京这一带。
examples.en: The guide said 'wild flowers by Zhuque Bridge…' describes this very part of Nanjing.

story.en: Liu Yuxi's poem on Wuyi Lane in Jinling (Nanjing), once home to the great Wang and Xie families of the Six Dynasties.
story.zh: 刘禹锡咏金陵乌衣巷之作，那里曾是六朝王、谢等世家大族的居住地。

usage.en: Quoted for the decline of former splendour; the couplet comes first and 旧时王谢堂前燕… follows. Literary register.
usage.zh: 用来感叹昔日繁华不再；这是前联，后联为“旧时王谢堂前燕……”。书面语。

text: 莫道桑榆晚，为霞尚满天
pinyin: mò dào sāng yú wǎn, wèi xiá shàng mǎn tiān
literal: don't · say · mulberry · elm · late, make · glow · still · fill · sky
natural: don't say the sun is low on the mulberries and elms: it still fills the sky with glow

meaning.en: Don't say it is too late in life: even a setting sun can paint the whole sky with colour.
meaning.zh: 不要说年纪已晚，夕阳也能把满天映成绚丽的晚霞。

equivalents: it is never too late
there is still glory in old age

examples.zh: 奶奶七十岁学画画，常念“莫道桑榆晚，为霞尚满天”。
examples.en: Grandmother took up painting at seventy and often recited 'don't say the sun is low: it still fills the sky with glow'.

examples.zh: 退休欢送会上，同事送他一句“莫道桑榆晚，为霞尚满天”。
examples.en: At his retirement party a colleague gave him the line 'don't say the sun is low: it still fills the sky with glow'.

origin.source: 刘禹锡《酬乐天咏老见示》

story.en: Liu Yuxi replied to Bai Juyi's poem on growing old with a more upbeat poem; these are its last two lines.
story.zh: 白居易作诗咏老，刘禹锡作诗酬答并表乐观，这是该诗最后两句。

usage.en: Encouragement for the elderly. It is often misattributed to Wang Bo's 《滕王阁序》 (which has 桑榆非晚); the line is Liu Yuxi's. 桑榆 means the setting sun and, by extension, old age. Literary register.
usage.zh: 用于勉励老年人。常被误作王勃《滕王阁序》（该文作“桑榆非晚”），实为刘禹锡诗。“桑榆”指落日，引申为晚年。书面语。

text: 春风十里扬州路，卷上珠帘总不如
pinyin: chūn fēng shí lǐ yáng zhōu lù, juǎn shàng zhū lián zǒng bù rú
literal: spring · breeze · ten · li · Yangzhou · road, roll · up · pearl · curtain · all · not · as good
natural: along ten miles of Yangzhou road in the spring breeze, no beauty behind rolled-up curtains compares

meaning.en: Along ten miles of Yangzhou's spring-breeze streets, none of the beauties glimpsed behind the rolled-up pearl curtains can match her.
meaning.zh: 春风吹拂的扬州十里长街上，卷起珠帘的佳人们，没有一个比得上她。

equivalents: outshines every other beauty

examples.zh: 他形容恋人，用了一句“春风十里扬州路，卷上珠帘总不如”。
examples.en: To describe his beloved he used the line 'along ten miles of Yangzhou road in the spring breeze, none behind rolled-up curtains compares'.

examples.zh: “春风十里扬州路，卷上珠帘总不如”常被人引来夸赞某人的风采。
examples.en: 'Along ten miles of Yangzhou road… none compares' is often quoted to praise someone's charm.

story.en: Du Mu wrote two farewell poems to a young singer in Yangzhou; the first begins '娉娉袅袅十三余，豆蔻梢头二月初'.
story.zh: 杜牧为告别扬州一位年轻歌女作二首赠别诗，第一首以“娉娉袅袅十三余，豆蔻梢头二月初”开头。

usage.en: Du Mu's praise of a thirteen-year-old singing girl in Yangzhou; today quoted to extol a person's beauty or the charm of Yangzhou. Literary register.
usage.zh: 杜牧称赞扬州一位十三岁歌女的诗句；今天多用来赞美佳人的风采，或形容扬州之美。书面语。

text: 多情却似总无情，唯觉樽前笑不成
pinyin: duō qíng què sì zǒng wú qíng, wéi jué zūn qián xiào bù chéng
literal: deep · feeling · yet · seems · always · without · feeling, only · feel · wine cup · before · smile · cannot · form
natural: so deeply feeling that I seem unfeeling; before the wine cup I simply cannot smile

meaning.en: At a farewell, too full of feeling to speak, I seem cold; before the wine cup I cannot even force a smile.
meaning.zh: 离别时感情太深，反倒显得冷淡无情，面对酒杯，连笑也笑不出来。

equivalents: too moved to show feeling
a heavy heart at parting

examples.zh: 送别宴上，两人相对无言，正应了“多情却似总无情，唯觉樽前笑不成”。
examples.en: At the farewell dinner the two sat speechless, just as in 'so deeply feeling that I seem unfeeling; before the wine cup I cannot smile'.

examples.zh: 毕业那天，他念起“多情却似总无情，唯觉樽前笑不成”。
examples.en: On graduation day he recited 'so deeply feeling that I seem unfeeling…'.

story.en: The second of Du Mu's two farewell poems to the Yangzhou singer; this is its first couplet.
story.zh: 杜牧赠别扬州歌女二首中的第二首，这是它的前两句。

usage.en: Quoted for the speechlessness of deep emotion at parting. Literary register.
usage.zh: 用来形容离别时情深而无语的状态。书面语。

text: 十年一觉扬州梦，赢得青楼薄幸名
pinyin: shí nián yī jué yáng zhōu mèng, yíng dé qīng lóu bó xìng míng
literal: ten · years · one · wake · Yangzhou · dream, win · gain · green · house · fickle · name
natural: ten years, and I wake from a Yangzhou dream with only a fickle lover's name from the pleasure quarters

meaning.en: After ten years I awake from the dream of Yangzhou, having won nothing but a reputation as a heartless man in the pleasure quarters.
meaning.zh: 十年的扬州生活像一场大梦，醒来只落得个在青楼中薄情负心的名声。

equivalents: a decade lost like a dream
wake from a long dream with nothing to show

examples.zh: 毕业十年，他回望往事，叹道：“十年一觉扬州梦，赢得青楼薄幸名。”
examples.en: Ten years after graduating he looked back and sighed, 'Ten years, and I wake from a Yangzhou dream with only a fickle lover's name.'

examples.zh: 读《遣怀》，“十年一觉扬州梦，赢得青楼薄幸名”写尽了诗人的自嘲与感伤。
examples.en: In 'Venting My Feelings', the line 'ten years, and I wake from a Yangzhou dream…' voices the poet's self-mockery and regret.

story.en: Du Mu wrote it in his later years, recalling his time at the court of Niu Sengru in Yangzhou; this is its closing couplet.
story.zh: 杜牧晚年回忆早年在扬州牛僧孺幕府的生活所作，这是诗的结尾两句。

usage.en: Du Mu looks back on his years as a young official in Yangzhou; quoted for regret over years lost to pleasure. Literary register.
usage.zh: 杜牧回顾早年在扬州任职时的生活；用来感叹岁月虚度、往事如梦。书面语。
